name: Haptic wire robot
group: Univ. of Nebraska Omaha / UNMC (Kamenskiy, MacTaggart)
target_anatomy: peripheral / prehospital use; bench stenosis tube
translation_detail: clamp-relay (servo-driven timing belt; gripper engaged on advance, released on retract)
haptics_leader: current-based impedance control with virtual mass-spring-damper; autonomous mode
validation_detail: flexible tubing with 20-80% stenosis inserts, 160 experiments (two current thresholds, rigid and flexible inserts)
key_numbers: 400 g; lesion stiffness F-score 0.83 / 0.77 / 0.95 (soft / medium / stiff); retractions rise with stenosis
